name: Sydney Access Scholarship
summary: Yearly scholarship for domestic commencing undergraduates who are regional, low-SES or facing financial hardship.
who: Domestic student who has applied for an undergraduate degree through UAC
Not eligible for a MySydney Entry and Scholarship
Regional or remote, recent regional school leaver, EAS financial hardship, or living in a bottom-25% ABS area
how: Apply through the domestic undergraduate scholarships page
catches: 2026 round opened 10 April 2026 and closed 9 October 2026; expect a new round next April

source.label: University of Sydney: Sydney Access Scholarship

evidence.quote: be facing financial hardship, as demonstrated through the UAC Educational Access Scheme (EAS)
